plain_english: May the Crusher protect always; may the Crusher guard forever.
sanskrit_cite: marddinī pātu satataṃ marddinī rakṣayet sadā

plain_english: May the Crusher protect always; may the Crusher guard forever.
sanskrit_cite: marddinī pātu satataṃ marddinī rakṣayet sadā

plain_english: May the Radiant One protect, O Great Goddess; may the Golden One guard always.
sanskrit_cite: prabhā pātu maheśāni kanakā sarvadāvatu

plain_english: May the Radiant One protect; may Great Illusion and Illusion always protect me.
sanskrit_cite: prabhā pātu mahāmāyā māyā pātu sadā mam

plain_english: May the Delightful One protect always; may the Very Radiant One guard at all times.
sanskrit_cite: nandinī pātu satataṃ suprabhā sarvadāvatu

plain_english: May the powers protect always; may they always protect my seal.
sanskrit_cite: śaktayaḥ pāntu satataṃ mudrāṃ pāntu sadā mam

plain_english: May the yoginīs protect always; may the sky-movers guard at all times.
sanskrit_cite: yoginyaḥ pāntu satataṃ khecaryaḥ pāntu sarvadā

plain_english: May the goddess, the Crusher of the Buffalo, protect everywhere and always.
sanskrit_cite: sarvatra sarvadā pātu devī mahiṣamarddinī

plain_english: Wherever one is, it must not be spoken; it must be carefully concealed.
sanskrit_cite: yatra tatra na vaktavyaṃ gopitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ

plain_english: Knowledge is easily found everywhere, but this great armor is hard to obtain.
sanskrit_cite: sarvatra sulabhā vidyā kavacaṃ durlabhaṃ mahat

plain_english: One should not show the divine hymn or the armor, which is hard for even the gods to obtain.
sanskrit_cite: na stavaṃ darśayeddivyaṃ kavacaṃ suradurlabham

plain_english: O Great Goddess, if it is given to them, one's powers perish gradually.
sanskrit_cite: dattvā tebhyo maheśāni naśyanti siddhayaḥ kramāt

plain_english: And inauspiciousness may come to him; therefore one should conceal it with effort.
sanskrit_cite: aśubhañca bhavet tasya tasmādyatnena gopayet

plain_english: Having written it during an auspicious conjunction, and likewise in Brahma-Indra and in Vaidhṛti...
sanskrit_cite: likhitvā śubhayoge ca brahmendre vaidhṛtau tathā

plain_english: In Vaṇija, in Śravaṇā, and in Revatī or in Punarvasu...
sanskrit_cite: vaṇije śravaṇāyāñca revatyāṃ vā punarvasau

plain_english: In Aśvinī or in Rohiṇī, or on the third or ninth lunar day...
sanskrit_cite: aśvinyāṃ vā rohiṇyāṃ vā tṛtīyānavamītithau

plain_english: On the new moon or on the full moon, at night, and likewise in a secluded place...
sanskrit_cite: kuhvāṃ vā pūrṇimāyāṃ vā niśāyāṃ prāntare tathā

plain_english: By a guru or by Vaiṣṇavas, and likewise with self-born flowers...
sanskrit_cite: guruṇā vaiṣṇavaurvapi svayambhūkusumaistathā

plain_english: Then one should wear the armor, a great protection that grants all desires.
sanskrit_cite: tadā dharenmahārakṣāṃ kavacaṃ sarvakāmadam

plain_english: Seeing him, an opponent becomes mute, and a king becomes like a servant.
sanskrit_cite: vādī mūko bhaveddṛṣṭvā rājā ca sevakāyate

plain_english: In six months or in three months, one certainly becomes a sky-mover.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaṇmāsairvā tribhirmāsaiḥ khecaro bhavati dhruvam

plain_english: One becomes disease-free and strong, and even a king may become a servant.
sanskrit_cite: arogī balavāṃścaiva rājā ca dāsatāmiyāt

plain_english: The wise one who acts thus is indeed the auspicious Sadāśiva.
sanskrit_cite: ya evaṃ kurute dhīmān sa eva śrīsadāśivaḥ

plain_english: As you are immovable, O Kṛṣṇā, so be steady in me.
sanskrit_cite: yathā tvamacalā kṛṣṇe tathā bhava mayi sthirā

plain_english: Padmā, the lotus-abiding goddess, is prosperity itself, supremely exalted and holding the auspicious lotus.
sanskrit_cite: padmā padmālayā sampaduccaiḥ śrīpadmadhāriṇī
